Title: Multiple Select
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to choose one or more options from the multi-select field, so that I can confirm all selections are reported correctly.

Priority: Medium
Acceptance Criteria:

* The user can select more than one option at once.
* The user can deselect a previously selected option.
* The Submit button sends all currently selected results.
* After submission, all selected options are displayed on the page.
* Resulting phrase template should be: "to go by <transport> to the <destination> <when>".

Title: Site Navigation
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to navigate through the site's menu (Homepage, Single UI Elements, Forms), so that I can confirm all listed pages load correctly.

Priority: Low
Acceptance Criteria:

* The left-hand menu displays: Homepage, Single UI Elements (Inputs, Buttons, Checkbox, Select, New tab, Text area, Alerts, Drag and Drop, Iframes, Pop-Up), and Forms (Practice Form).
* Each menu item navigates to the correct corresponding page.
* The currently active page is visually highlighted in the menu.
* The "Not sure where to start?" quick-start list on the homepage (Text input, Simple button, Single checkbox, Text area, Select input) links to the correct pages.

Title: Password Field
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to enter text into the Password field, so that I can confirm it enforces the required complexity rules.

Priority: High
Acceptance Criteria:

* Minimum length of 8 characters is enforced.
* At least one uppercase letter is required.
* At least one lowercase letter is required.
* At least one digit is required.
* At least one special character is required.
* Passwords failing any rule are rejected with an appropriate error.
* The form can be submitted by pressing Enter.
* After submission, the entered text is displayed on the page.

Title: Text Input Field
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to enter text into the Text Input field, so that I can confirm it validates and submits correctly.

Priority: High
Acceptance Criteria:

* The field is required; submitting it empty shows a validation error.
* Only English letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens are accepted as valid input.
* Text shorter than 2 characters is rejected.
* Text longer than 25 characters is rejected (or truncated/blocked at the limit).
* The form can be submitted by pressing Enter, without clicking Submit.
* After submission, the entered text is displayed on the page.

Title: Email Field
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to enter text into the Email field, so that I can confirm only valid email addresses are accepted.

Priority: High
Acceptance Criteria:

* A valid email format (e.g., [user@example.com|mailto:user@example.com]) is accepted.
* The "localhost" domain (e.g., user@localhost) is accepted as valid.
* Invalid formats (missing "@", missing domain, spaces, etc.) are rejected with an error.
* The form can be submitted by pressing Enter.
* After submission, the entered email is displayed on the page.

Title: Simple Button
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to click the Simple Button, so that I can confirm it responds correctly to a click.

Priority: Medium
Acceptance Criteria:

* The button is labeled "Click."
* The button is clickable/enabled by default.
* Clicking the button triggers the expected action/response (e.g., visible confirmation).

Title: Disabled Button
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to toggle the enable/disable control for the Submit button, so that I can confirm its enabled/disabled state behaves correctly.

Priority: Medium
Acceptance Criteria:

* The Submit button is disabled by default.
* The user can enable the button via the provided control.
* The user can subsequently disable the button again via the same control.
* A disabled button cannot be clicked/submitted.
* An enabled button can be clicked/submitted successfully.

Title: Looks Like a Button" Element
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to interact with the element styled to look like a button, so that I can confirm its actual underlying behavior matches (or intentionally differs from) a real button.

Priority: Medium
Acceptance Criteria:

* The element is visually styled like a standard button.
* *(To confirm on page - verify actual tag/role, e.g., whether it is a real {{<button>}}, a styled {{<div>}}/{{<span>}}/{{<a>}}, and whether it is keyboard-accessible and clickable as expected.)

Title: Single Checkbox
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to select/deselect the single checkbox, so that I can confirm the result is reported correctly on submit.

Priority: Medium
Acceptance Criteria:

* There is exactly one checkbox on the page, labeled "Select me or not."
* The user can select and deselect the checkbox.
* The Submit button is always enabled, regardless of checkbox state.
* If the checkbox was not selected at submit time, no result is displayed.
* If the checkbox was selected at submit time, the checkbox's name is displayed to the user.

Title: Multiple Checkboxes
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to select any combination of the three checkboxes, so that I can confirm all selected values are reported correctly on submit.

Priority: Medium
Acceptance Criteria:

* There are exactly three checkboxes labeled "One," "Two," and "Three."
* The user can select any checkbox, in any combination.
* The Submit button is always enabled.
* If no checkbox is selected at submit time, no result is displayed.
* If one or more checkboxes are selected, the name(s) of all selected checkboxes are displayed.

Title: Single Select
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to choose an option from the "Choose language" dropdown, so that I can confirm the selection is validated and reported correctly.

Priority: Medium
Acceptance Criteria:

* The field is labeled "Choose language" and is required.
* Submitting without a selection shows a validation error.
* The user can select any available option.
* The Submit button sends the selected result.
* After submission, the selected option is displayed on the page.

Title: New Tab Link
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to click the "New tab" link, so that I can confirm it opens the correct page in a new browser tab.

Priority: Low
Acceptance Criteria:

* Clicking the link opens a new browser tab (not the same tab).
* The new tab loads the expected destination page.
* The original tab remains open and unchanged.

Title: New Tab Button
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to click the "New tab" button, so that I can confirm it opens the correct page in a new browser tab.

Priority: Low
Acceptance Criteria:

* Clicking the button opens the page {{/elements/new\\_tab/new\\_page}}.
* The page opens in a new browser tab, not the current one.
* The original tab remains open and unchanged.

Title: Single Text Area
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to enter text into the "Text area" field, so that I can confirm it validates and submits correctly.

Priority: Medium
Acceptance Criteria:

* The field is labeled "Text area" and is required.
* Submitting without entering text shows a validation error.
* The user can enter any text into the field.
* The Submit button sends the entered text.
* After submission, the entered text is displayed on the page.

Title: Multiple Text Areas
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to enter text into the "First chapter," "Second chapter," and "Third chapter" fields, so that I can confirm each field validates and submits independently.

Priority: Medium
Acceptance Criteria:

* All three fields ("First chapter," "Second chapter," "Third chapter") are present.
* Only "First chapter" is required; the other two are optional.
* Submitting with "First chapter" empty shows a validation error.
* The user can enter any text into each field.
* After submission, the text entered into all fields is displayed on the page.

Title: Alert Box
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to trigger the JS alert box, so that I can confirm its content and dismissal behavior.

Priority: Medium
Acceptance Criteria:

* A "Click" button is present on the page.
* Clicking it displays a native alert containing the text "I am an alert!"
* The alert has an OK button.
* Clicking OK closes the alert.

Title: Confirmation Box
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to trigger the JS confirmation box and choose OK or Cancel, so that I can confirm the correct result is recorded for each choice.

Priority: Medium
Acceptance Criteria:

* A "Click" button is present on the page.
* Clicking it displays a native confirm dialog containing the text "I am an alert!"
* The dialog has OK and Cancel buttons.
* Choosing OK records/displays the corresponding result ("You selected" OK).
* Choosing Cancel records/displays the corresponding result ("You selected" Cancel).

Title: Prompt Box
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to trigger the JS prompt box, enter text, and choose OK or Cancel, so that I can confirm the entered value and choice are handled correctly.

Priority: Medium
Acceptance Criteria:

* A "Click" button is present on the page.
* Clicking it displays a native prompt containing the text "I am an alert!"
* The prompt has OK and Cancel buttons plus a text input field.
* Submitting with OK records/displays the text the user entered.
* Choosing Cancel does not record/display any entered text.

Title: Boxes
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to drag the bottom square into the top square, so that I can confirm the drag-and-drop feature works correctly for the Boxes tab.

Priority: Medium
Acceptance Criteria:

* Two squares are displayed: "Drop here" (top) and "Drag me" (bottom).
* The bottom square can be dragged and dropped onto the top square.
* On a successful drop, the text "Dropped!" appears inside the top square.
* The bottom square can only be dragged once; a second drag attempt has no effect.

Title: Images
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to drag the smiley image between the two squares repeatedly, so that I can confirm the drag-and-drop feature works correctly and without restriction for the Images tab.

Priority: Medium
Acceptance Criteria:

* Two squares are displayed, with the smiley initially in the top square.
* There should be a smiley in the bottom square
* The smiley can be dragged between the two squares an unlimited number of times.
* On a successful drop, the text "Dropped!" appears in the square that received the smiley.
* The square that does not contain the smiley remains completely empty.

Title: Iframe Page
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to locate and interact with elements inside the embedded iframe, so that I can confirm the iframe content loads and is accessible correctly.

Priority: Medium
Acceptance Criteria:

* An iframe containing a sample page is present on the page.
* The iframe's content loads correctly and is visible.
* Elements inside the iframe can be located and interacted with independently of the parent page.

Title: Modal Pop-Up
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to launch the modal Pop-Up, select a checkbox, and send or cancel, so that I can confirm the correct value is passed back to the page.

Priority: Medium
Acceptance Criteria:

* A button named "Launch Pop-Up" is present and opens the Pop-Up.
* The Pop-Up title reads "I am a Pop-Up."
* The Pop-Up contains a checkbox labeled "Select me or not."
* The Pop-Up has two buttons: "Cancel" and "Send."
* Clicking "Send" passes the checkbox's selected value back to the main page.
* The value sent is displayed in a "Selected checkboxes" section on the page.
* The "Selected checkboxes" section is not present until a value has been sent at least once via the Pop-Up.
* Clicking "Cancel" closes the Pop-Up without sending any value.

Title: Iframe Pop-Up
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to enter text into a field located inside an iframe within a Pop-Up, so that I can confirm the input is validated correctly.

Priority: Medium
Acceptance Criteria:

* The Pop-Up contains an iframe with an input field.
* Entering the correct expected text and submitting shows a green "Correct!" message.
* Entering incorrect text and submitting shows a yellow "Nope." message (or equivalent negative feedback).

Title: Required Field Validation
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to submit the Student Registration form with required fields left empty, so that I can confirm validation correctly blocks submission.

Priority: High
Acceptance Criteria:

* First Name, Last Name, Gender, and Mobile are marked as required (*).
* Submitting the form with any required field empty displays a validation error and does not submit.
* Filling in all required fields (leaving optional fields empty) allows successful submission.

Title: Mobile Number Validation
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to enter various values into the Mobile field, so that I can confirm only a valid 10-digit number is accepted.

Priority: High
Acceptance Criteria:

* The field accepts exactly 10 digits.
* Non-numeric characters are rejected.
* Fewer than 10 digits is rejected on submit.
* More than 10 digits is either blocked from entry or rejected on submit.

Title: Gender Selection
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to select each Gender option, so that I can confirm only one option can be active at a time.

Priority: Medium
Acceptance Criteria:

* Options "Male," "Female," and "Other" are shown as radio buttons.
* Only one option can be selected at a time.
* Gender is required for submission.

Title: Subjects Field
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to enter text into the "Subjects" field and move focus away or press Enter, so that I can confirm the entered text is retained.

Priority: High
Acceptance Criteria:

* Text entered into the Subject field is retained after clicking outside the field (on blur).
* Text entered into the Subject field is retained after pressing Enter.
* The entered subject appears correctly if the field supports multiple tag-style entries (verify against intended design).

Title: Hobbies Selection
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to select any combination of Hobbies checkboxes, so that I can confirm multiple selections are supported and retained.

Priority: Low
Acceptance Criteria:

* Options "Sports," "Reading," and "Music" are available as checkboxes.
* Any combination (including none, one, or all) can be selected.
* Selected hobbies are retained through form submission and reflected in the confirmation.

Title: Picture Upload
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to upload a picture using the Picture field, so that I can confirm only supported file types/sizes are accepted.

Priority: Medium
Acceptance Criteria:

* The field accepts standard image file types (e.g., JPG, PNG).
* Non-image files are rejected with an appropriate error.
* The selected file name is displayed once chosen.
* The user can replace a previously selected file with a new one before submitting.

Title: State/City Dependent Selects
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to select a State and then a City, so that I can confirm the City list correctly depends on the selected State.

Priority: Medium
Acceptance Criteria:

* The State dropdown includes "Select State," "NCR," "Uttar Pradesh," "Haryana," "Rajasthan."
* The City dropdown is empty/disabled until a State is chosen ("Select City" placeholder shown).
* Selecting a State populates the City dropdown with cities relevant to that State only.
* Changing the State after a City is already selected resets/updates the City field appropriately.

Title: Successfull Submission
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to fill in all required fields correctly and submit the form, so that I can confirm the confirmation modal appears as expected.

Priority: High
Acceptance Criteria:

* With all required fields filled in validly, clicking Submit succeeds without errors.
* A confirmation modal appears with the heading "Thanks for submitting the form."
* The modal has a "Close" button that dismisses it.
* After closing, the form is left in a consistent state (either cleared or as defined by design - verify expected behavior).

Title: Ad Placeholder Overlap
Description / Acceptance Criteria:
As a QA engineer, I want to verify the ad placeholder does not overlap interactive form fields, so that I can confirm all fields remain clickable and usable.

Priority: Low
Acceptance Criteria:

* The ad placeholder is rendered in its designated area only.
* No form field, label, or button is obscured or made unclickable by the ad placeholder at common screen resolutions.
* Automated locators for form fields are not intercepted by the ad placeholder element.
